modules.title: 一个失效地址怎样成为真正的 404 页面
找不到页面需要同时表达什么

items.title: 状态告诉系统资源不存在
items.text: 服务器对不存在的 URL 返回 404，浏览器和搜索系统才能知道这次请求没有找到资源。页面正文可以更友好，但不能用 200 假装请求成功。

items.title: 入口帮助用户恢复
items.text: 返回列表、站内搜索或上一级页面能让用户继续完成任务。入口应和当前内容有关，不能把所有错误都没有说明地送回首页。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 找不到页面处理的是资源不存在；Result 是一个已经结束的流程对用户说明成功、失败或处理中；Redirect 是旧地址确实有对应新地址时改变访问目标。空列表也不是 404，因为列表本身存在，只是当前没有内容。

lessonPractice.title: 访问不存在的文章地址时，页面显示“找不到”，但 Network 显示 200。下一步应该做什么？

options.label: 让这个地址返回 404，同时保留说明和返回文章列表的入口
options.feedback: 对。资源不存在时，页面提示和 HTTP 状态都要表达同一个事实，返回入口再帮助用户恢复。

options.label: 把页面改成结果页，显示“操作失败”并提供重新提交按钮
options.feedback: 这里没有一个已经结束的提交流程，重试操作也不能让不存在的文章出现；问题首先是资源和状态不匹配。

options.label: 把所有不存在的地址重定向到首页，并继续返回成功状态
options.feedback: 无关地址被送到首页会丢失用户上下文，也掩盖了资源确实不存在的事实；只有有明确替代内容时才应重定向。

en.title: An unknown article URL shows a Not Found message, but Network reports 200. What should happen next?

options.label: Return 404 for the URL while keeping the explanation and a link back to the article list
options.feedback: Correct. The page message and HTTP status should describe the same missing resource, with a recovery path for the user.

options.label: Turn it into a result page that says Operation failed and offers a resubmit button
options.feedback: No completed submission flow exists here, and retrying cannot create a missing article. The first problem is the resource and status mismatch.

options.label: Redirect every unknown URL to the home page and keep returning a success status
options.feedback: Sending unrelated URLs to the home page loses context and hides that the resource is missing. Redirect only when a matching replacement exists.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请让不存在的文章 URL 返回 HTTP 404，并显示清楚的找不到页面、返回文章列表和搜索入口。用浏览器 Network 检查状态，再检查页面上的恢复链接；如果某篇文章只是换了地址，单独把旧地址重定向到对应的新页面。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Make unknown article URLs return HTTP 404 with a clear not-found page, a link back to the article list, and a search entry. Check the status in Network and then test the recovery links. If an article only moved, redirect its old URL to the matching new page instead.

learning.assumes: You have opened a broken link or seen a request status in a browser's Network panel.
learning.outcome: You can check whether an unknown URL really returns 404 and distinguish an error page from a flow result or redirect.

modules.title: How a broken address becomes a real 404 page
What a not-found page must communicate

items.title: The status tells systems the resource is missing
items.text: The server returns 404 for an unknown URL so browsers and search systems know the request found no resource. The page can be friendly, but it should not pretend success with 200.

items.title: Recovery links help people continue
items.text: A list, site search, or parent-page link can help people continue. The path should relate to the missing content instead of silently sending every error to the home page.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A not-found page handles a missing resource. A Result page reports success, failure, or processing after a flow ends. A Redirect changes the destination when an old URL has a matching new one. An empty list is not 404 because the list exists; it simply has no current items.
